full_path1/file1.py

```

Based on the simulator error, the crossbar is instantiating the error‐slave (`axi_err_slv`) and attempting to hook its `slv_resp_o` port to the crossbar’s own `slv_resp_o` port—i.e. two outputs driving each other. The fix will involve:

1. Changing the direction (or name) of the `slv_resp_o` port in the crossbar so that it becomes an input (or matches the error‐slave’s side).  
2. Ensuring that `axi_err_slv.sv` still declares `slv_resp_o` correctly as an output.  

The two files containing those port declarations and the instantiation are:

```  
ips/axi/axi/src/axi_xbar.sv
ips/axi/axi/src/axi_err_slv.sv
```
